Title: Running yabai with SIP enabled, will signals work?
Description: Thanks for a great software!

I'm running yabai with SIP enabled. I'm trying to get signals to work with a bitbar plugin.

I've added the following signals and is not getting any output in the error or out log. But still its not being triggered at least to my knowledge :)

```
# yabai -m signal --add event=space_changed \
#   action="set SHELL=/bin/sh && open -g \"bitbar://refreshPlugin?name=yabai-window-info.*?.sh\""
# yabai -m signal --add event=window_resized \
#   action="set SHELL=/bin/sh && open -g \"bitbar://refreshPlugin?name=yabai-window-info.*?.sh\""
# yabai -m signal --add event=window_focused \
#   action="set SHELL=/bin/sh && open -g \"bitbar://refreshPlugin?name=yabai-window-info.*?.sh\""
# yabai -m signal --add event=application_activated \
#   action="set SHELL=/bin/sh && open -g \"bitbar://refreshPlugin?name=yabai-window-info.*?.sh\""
```

So my question was if we're suppose to add this to the list below in the WIKI if its a requirement to disable SIP in order for it to work.

```
The following features of yabai require System Integrity Protection to be disabled:

focus/create/destroy space without animation
move space (and its windows) left, right or to another display
remove window shadows
enable window transparency
control window layers (make windows appear topmost)
sticky windows (make windows appear on all spaces)
move window by clicking anywhere in its frame
```
